song.title: I Want To Know What Love Is

guitar.notes: Mick Jones plays a mix of Les Pauls and Stratocasters; no single ultra-iconic guitar, medium is accurate.

tone.target: clean, spacious 80s chorus guitar with glossy sustain
tone.profile: clean, spacious 80s chorus guitar with glossy sustain
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing light compression, a Chorus effect for the signature 80s sound, followed by a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with a bright cab (US 2x12), finished with subtle delay and reverb.
